terminals.name: dsh-web
terminals.description: DeepSeek Harness web workbench (host server + browser UI) on http://127.0.0.1:3080. The startup log prints a tokenized URL; open it to exchange the token for a session cookie. Sending a chat turn to a real model needs credentials, but the server and UI load without a key. The PATH prefix keeps commands on Node 24 (the repo requires >=22.19) since the Cursor sandbox may otherwise resolve an older node first.

terminals.name: xyos-backend
terminals.command: export PATH="/usr/bin:$PATH"; cd xyos-backend && JWT_SECRET="${JWT_SECRET:-$(openssl rand -hex 32)}" COOKIE_SECRET="${COOKIE_SECRET:-$(openssl rand -hex 32)}" npm run dev
terminals.description: XYOS local backend (Express + embedded SQLite via sql.js) on http://127.0.0.1:3000. Seeds a demo tenant on first boot (login demo@demo.com / demo123). Uses ephemeral JWT/COOKIE secrets unless JWT_SECRET and COOKIE_SECRET are provided. The PATH prefix keeps commands on Node 24 (see dsh-web).
